paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah, chapter 19, section 3, and perhaps he is Abba Halifa Keruya.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The possible identification with Abba Chalifa Keruya is Hyman’s conjecture.

Perhaps he is Abba Halifa Keruya is Hyman’s conjecture, with perhaps intact. Kurya and Keruya and the supplied bar remain distinct forms, without an identity merge or added rank. Bereshit Rabbah19:3 is the conventional chapter/section expansion; no named edition or modern locator mapping was checked.
